title: Make CEC-MQTT-Bridge Robust and Reliable
description: Epic to address reliability issues with the CEC-MQTT bridge, focusing on preventing unwanted device power state changes and improving overall stability for Home Assistant integration.

title: Implement robust MQTT reconnection logic
description: Currently has retry logic on initial connection but no handling for MQTT connection drops after initial connection. Need to implement on_disconnect handler with exponential backoff and automatic reconnection.

title: Add health monitoring and metrics
description: Need visibility into bridge health for debugging and proactive issue detection. Add health check endpoints, metrics collection (MQTT messages sent/received, CEC errors, connection uptime), and alerting for degraded states.

title: Add systemd service hardening and restart policies
description: Current service configuration lacks proper restart policies and resource limits. Need to add Restart=always, RestartSec, CPU/Memory limits, and proper logging configuration for production use.

title: Migrate from original michaelarnauts version to ballle98 fork
description: Currently running old version from michaelarnauts repository. The ballle98 fork has improvements including better CEC handling, MQTT topic structure, and code organization. Need to safely migrate configuration and verify compatibility.

comments.author: addadi
comments.text: Package built and installed successfully. Modified bridge.py to handle optional lirc import gracefully. Testing requires MQTT broker to be running.

comments.author: addadi
comments.text: New bridge tested - connects to MQTT broker successfully. However, CEC device access conflicts with old bridge (ioctl errno 16). Created new systemd service file at ~/src/cec-mqtt-bridge-ballle98/cec-mqtt-bridge.service with Restart=always and 10s restart delay. Need to stop old service and install new one.

comments.author: addadi
comments.text: Fixed module import issue by switching to python3 -m module call instead of using script. Updated service file to use ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -m cec_mqtt_bridge.bridge. Service file ready at /tmp/cec-mqtt-bridge.service. User needs to install it with: sudo cp /tmp/cec-mqtt-bridge.service /etc/systemd/system/ && sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl start cec-mqtt-bridge

comments.author: addadi
comments.text: Service is running successfully! Connected to MQTT broker and CEC device. Waiting for first refresh cycle to see device discovery logs. Bridge running as user 'addadi' with proper environment variables.

comments.author: addadi
comments.text: SUCCESS! Bridge is working with new topic structure. Home Assistant updated to use media/cec/device/0/power/set format instead of old media/cec/power/0/set format. Migration complete - bridge is running, connected to MQTT and CEC, receiving and processing commands successfully.

title: Add CEC connection loss handling and auto-reconnect
description: The current implementation doesn't gracefully handle CEC adapter disconnections or failures. Need to implement monitoring of CEC connection status and automatic reconnection when the connection is lost.

title: Investigate and fix projector auto-power-on issue
description: The projector automatically turns on after shutdown when cec-mqtt-bridge service is running. Stopping the service prevents this behavior. Need to identify the root cause (likely CEC activity during refresh cycle or CEC adapter initialization) and implement a fix.
